name: open-cpap-parser
description: Multi-manufacturer CPAP data parsing library and CLI

architect.description: Senior Python architect — designs schema, adapter patterns, and data contracts
architect.instructions: Focus on pydantic schema design, adapter pattern extensibility, and PostgreSQL-friendly output. Never introduce non-portable paths or secrets.

implementer.instructions: Follow the adapter pattern defined in adapters/base.py. Use cpap-py for ResMed EDF parsing. Keep tests green against real data at all times.

rules: Never commit real patient data or test data paths to the repository
Keep the .opencode/ directory portable — no secrets or local paths
Run `uv run pytest tests/` before marking any work complete
